author: reek
body: Smoke test for nRF52840 board drivers. MMIO stubs return 0 on the hosted VM, so this exercises the driver logic and bit manipulation without real hardware. Task/event waits terminate immediately since event registers read as 0 (fuel-bounded loops).

author: reek
body: The BLE beacon builder and the GATT attribute tables are pure -- they assemble bytes and never reach the radio -- so they are bound with plain lets. If someone gives one of them a register access later, those lines stop compiling.
